news.title: Purdue's LyoHUB to open pharmaceutical fill-finish innovation facility built on $3M+ equipment donation from Merck
news.summary_en: The LyoHUB’s new technology innovation facility will give researchers, industry and government partners hands-on access to state-of-the-art, current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) equipment for parenteral fill-finish and lyophilization, a first of its kind in an academic setting.

news.title: Purdue Engineering students use AI to tackle societal challenges in ShahLab.AI competition
news.summary_en: Seven Purdue Engineering student teams presented AI-driven solutions to real-world social and economic challenges on Oct. 21 during Phase 2 of the 2026 ShahLab.AI: AI For Social Good competition.
